title: A real crossed two-node auxiliary graph exactly implements unequal parity residues
statement: A positive two-side-node graph Hside=Omega0*I+J*sigma_x and G=g_d*I+g_c*sigma_x implements the certified parity poles exactly via G*(Hside-E)^-1*Gtranspose. Strict reflection-symmetric two-node matching-only contacts cannot reproduce the required unequal parity residues.

requires: Exact two positive poles/residues and the displayed real crossed auxiliary graph; same spectral Hamiltonian.
The local-only obstruction additionally fixes a nondegenerate reflection-symmetric two-node side graph and matching contacts only.
provides: A positive two-side-node graph Hside=Omega0*I+J*sigma_x and G=g_d*I+g_c*sigma_x implements the certified parity poles exactly via G*(Hside-E)^-1*Gtranspose. Strict reflection-symmetric two-node matching-only contacts cannot reproduce the required unequal parity residues.
assumptions: An exact basis transformation is not a fabricated cavity network or demonstrated accessible cross-contact.
costs: Two positive side nodes and cross-contact almost90 percent of direct contact; no passive local-only simplification for this exact two-node target.
contract.units: Omega0,J,g_d,g_c have energy units B; residuesB^2; basis transformation dimensionless.
contract.obstruction: Derive actual accessible contacts including all baths and geometry before using the physical network.

body: Choose Omega0=(Omega_plus+Omega_minus)/2,J=(Omega_plus-Omega_minus)/2,g_d=(sqrt(r_plus)+sqrt(r_minus))/2,g_c=(sqrt(r_plus)-sqrt(r_minus))/2. The common orthogonal parity basis simultaneously diagonalizes Hside and G, giving r_p/(Omega_p-E) exactly, so the stationary band and capacity results transfer to this same Hamiltonian. All couplings are real and side eigenvalues positive; numerical matrix samples are unnecessary for the identity. Cross/direct coupling is about0.899643. With only G=diag(g1,g2) and a nondegenerate reflection-symmetric side graph, parity commutation for every E forces |g1|=|g2| and equal residues, contrary to r_plus/r_minus about358.3. This excludes this stricter exact target, not all local networks, larger buses or approximate designs. The supplied bus script has a missing design import and its residual report was not independently replayed.
